chunks: Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام said: The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said:
O Allah, have mercy on my successors.
It was said: O Messenger of Allah, and who are your successors?
He said: Those who come after me and narrate my hadith and my sunnah (prophetic tradition).

key_terms.اللَّهُمَّ: An invocation to Allah in the form of supplication.
key_terms.حَدِيثِي: My hadith; the Prophet’s transmitted sayings and reports.
key_terms.خُلَفَائِي: My successors; those described here as carrying forward the Prophet’s legacy.
key_terms.سُنَّتِي: My sunnah (prophetic tradition); the normative prophetic way.

ai.seo_question: Who are the Prophet’s successors according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith records a supplication of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم for mercy upon his successors. He explains that they are those who come after him and transmit his hadith and his sunnah (prophetic tradition), highlighting the noble rank of preserving and conveying authentic religious knowledge.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.5919 - Commander of the Faithful Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as), peace be upon him, said:
The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said:
"O' Allah (swt), have mercy on my successors."
It was asked: "O' Messenger of Allah (swt), who are your successors?"
Prophet (sw) replied: "Those who come after me and narrate my traditions and my Sunnah."
